selections.rationale: Strong partner co-sell leadership, architecture specificity, regulated-industry context, and a quantified joint-revenue outcome.
Connects technically credible HPC and ML-enabled pipelines to executive workflows without overstating generative-AI experience.
Clear customer-facing pre-sales arc from technical discovery and buyer priorities through demonstrations and delivery handoffs.
Shows portfolio-level expansion leadership and governed decision support while avoiding the less precise quota-aligned phrasing.
Demonstrates alliance GTM execution through joint planning, solution architecture, and an operating cadence without duplicating the revenue claim.
